description:
## Why this ticket exists

v0.3's headline is the menubar view, and this ticket turns the research-proven prototype into the production Swift helper. The plan (`product-architecture-2026-07-30.md`, "Empirically verified" + "UI") records: a bundle-less Swift `NSStatusItem` helper was proven end-to-end at **112 KB universal, ~45 MB RSS, stdio JSON-lines IPC**; Electron measured 122/304/196 MB with postinstall failures and was rejected for v1. **Important scope fact: that prototype source is NOT in the repo** — `spikes/` contains only `spikes/rounding`; the helper was built and validated live during the 2026-07-30 research workflow (transcripts referenced at the top of the plan doc). This ticket therefore includes bringing helper source into the monorepo (the plan's verdict architecture lists "Swift helper source" as a monorepo package inside the single npm tarball).

Decision D3 (DECIDED) shapes the title: user-selectable title modes, **$ today default, picker phase-gated** — $ + burn ship in v0.3, quota joins v0.5 and must not appear earlier.

## Scope (in)

- **Title**: monospaced digits; overflow contract exactly as specified — `$0.00`–`$999.99` verbatim → `$1.0k+` compaction → icon-only fallback.
- **Mode picker**: exposes only shipped modes — $ today (default) + burn $/hr. No quota entry (v0.5).
- **v1 NSMenu dropdown**, exact order per plan: header (today / week / Δ) → burn strip → Claude-vs-Codex + model split → top-5 projects combined $ → refresh / settings / Stop service / Quit menubar.
- **stdio JSON-lines IPC hardening**: helper exits on stdin EOF (orphan prevention); malformed lines tolerated without crashing (skip and continue); bounded message handling.
- **Crash-loop breaker** (host side): N helper exits within 60 s ⇒ stop respawning and set health state, surfaced per the quality-bar ruling "quiet self-heal + health dot + doctor; crash-loop breaker on the helper".
- **Universal-binary CI**: macOS runner, both slices (arm64 + x86_64), `lipo`, declared `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` and macOS support matrix; helper size measured in CI against the **1 MB packed-tarball threshold** as a **hard gate** — the build FAILS above it, and exceeding it additionally opens the platform-split revisit (ISS-035: a threshold that only flags is not a gate; this matches this ticket's own "deterministic checks are hard CI gates" ruling below).
- **Tarball-level release tests** per plan: `npm pack` → inspect contents/modes/slices/signature → clean-prefix install → helper IPC handshake.

## Scope (out)

- NSPopover + SwiftUI rich popover — v0.4, explicitly "de-risk bundle-less first".
- Notifications / SMAppService — need the flat `.app` (v0.5, or earlier only if D4/T-016 forces it).
- Quota mode (v0.5). Attach/LaunchAgent semantics (T-015). Signing/notarization decisions (T-016).

## Approach notes & constraints

- Helper stays a **bare executable, ad-hoc signed** (empirically sufficient on the npm extraction path, n=1) unless T-016 decides otherwise; if D4 pulls the flat `.app` forward, packaging changes land there, not here.
- `process.platform === 'darwin'` guard with clear capability messages elsewhere.
- Helper is a pure view — all data arrives over IPC from the node host; the IPC message schema is not defined by the plan and must be designed here (keep cost formatting/business logic in the TS side to preserve the single-source-of-truth rendering).
- The v0.3 phase exit applies: **live $ ≤ 2 s; idle CPU ≈ 0**; per quality rulings, deterministic checks (sizes, counts) are hard CI gates while wall-clock numbers are recorded-baseline comparisons. The 1 MB packed-size threshold is a deterministic check and therefore a hard gate — criterion 2 below is written to fail, not to warn.
- Standing constraints: `package.json` never carries an `author` field (contract test exists — keep green); no real transcript data or personal paths in fixtures.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Swift helper source lives in the monorepo and builds in CI on a macOS runner; `lipo -archs` on the produced binary reports both arm64 and x86_64; `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` is explicitly declared in the build and recorded in CI/docs.
2. CI measures the packed tarball size and **fails the run** when the helper pushes the packed size past the 1 MB threshold from the plan; the failure output names the threshold and the measured size, and exceeding the threshold also opens the platform-split revisit as an explicit tracked item (issue or ticket), not only a log line. A run that warns while exiting green does not satisfy this criterion (ISS-035/ISS-036 — the "reports rather than fails" defect class).
3. Title rendering is boundary-tested: $0.00 and $999.99 render verbatim; $1000.00 renders in $1.0k+ compacted form; the fallback beyond compaction renders icon-only; digits use monospaced-digit font attributes.
4. Mode picker shows exactly two modes ($ today default, burn $/hr) and no quota entry; NSMenu contains exactly the plan's sections in the plan's order (header today/week/Δ, burn strip, Claude-vs-Codex + model split, top-5 projects combined $, refresh/settings/Stop service/Quit menubar).
5. IPC tests prove: helper exits cleanly within a bounded time when stdin reaches EOF; a malformed JSON line is skipped and a subsequent valid line still updates the title.
6. Crash-loop test: with the helper forced to exit immediately, the host stops respawning after the configured threshold within the 60 s window, sets health state, and the condition is visible to doctor/health surfaces.
7. Release test passes: `npm pack` → inspect tarball contents/file modes/slices/signature → install into a clean prefix → helper launches and completes an IPC handshake, scripted end-to-end.
8. Idle CPU of host+helper is ≈ 0, verified as a recorded-baseline comparison (v0.3 phase exit), and live $ appears in the title within ≤ 2 s warm.
9. package.json still has no author field and no fixture introduced by this ticket contains real transcript data or personal paths.

## Risks
The prototype Swift source is not committed anywhere in the repo — productionizing means re-deriving from the research-workflow transcripts, so behavior regressions vs the proven prototype are possible. Bundle-less NSStatusItem behavior beyond the n=1 prototype machine (dark mode, multiple displays, older macOS in the declared support matrix) is unverified. If T-016 (D4) forces the flat .app forward, helper packaging churns after this ticket lands. Two respawn layers (this ticket's host-side breaker, launchd KeepAlive on the service in T-015) must not fight each other.

## Open questions (owner decisions)
1. Minimum supported macOS version / MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: the plan mandates that a support matrix be declared but never picks the floor — owner call.
2. The v1 NSMenu includes a 'settings' item but the settings surface ships in v0.4 — what should the v0.3 settings item do (hidden, disabled, or open the config file)?
title: Productionize Swift helper: title modes, NSMenu, IPC hardening, crash-loop breaker
